sections.title: Four kinds of persona tool
sections.what: Describes the four tool kinds: a live link tool, an open-data tool with proof and credit, an illustrative example tool, and a pending placeholder.
sections.why: The comment says readers must know where the data comes from.
sections.watch_out: The illustrative kind has no credit line or proof, so pages must add a clear example label themselves.

summary: Defines the Roster's persona tools: four kinds, each with a title and note, and each marked as live, open data, illustrative or pending.
purpose: Tells the Roster page how to show each persona's signature tool and what kind of data sits behind it.
why: The comment says the kind tells readers whether a tool is live, based on open data, or illustrative.
how: 1. A live tool links to the Lab. 2. An open-data tool has rows with proof and attribution. 3. An illustrative tool has example rows. 4. A pending tool has only a title and note.
risks: Types do not force an illustrative tool to be clearly labelled, so the page must show the kind.
debug: If a tool shows the wrong label, check its kind value.
